_comment: DO NOT EDIT: FILE GENERATED FOR PTERODACTYL PANEL - PTERODACTYL.IO
name: RoomFlow Townsquare Sync Station
author: noreply@roomflow.local
description: Always-on RoomFlow browser worker. Runs Chromium, the draft-only Townsquare bridge extension, a local queue controller, and password-protected noVNC. Requires the RoomFlow Sync Station container image.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
apt-get update
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates git
ROOMFLOW_INSTALL_SOURCE=/tmp/roomflow-sync-station-install
rm -rf "$ROOMFLOW_INSTALL_SOURCE"
git clone --depth 1 --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" "$ROOMFLOW_INSTALL_SOURCE"
test -f "$ROOMFLOW_INSTALL_SOURCE/sync-station/server.mjs"
test -f "$ROOMFLOW_INSTALL_SOURCE/townsquare-bridge-extension/manifest.json"
mkdir -p /mnt/server/sync-station /mnt/server/townsquare-bridge-extension
cp -R "$ROOMFLOW_INSTALL_SOURCE/sync-station/." /mnt/server/sync-station/
cp -R "$ROOMFLOW_INSTALL_SOURCE/townsquare-bridge-extension/." /mnt/server/townsquare-bridge-extension/
chmod 0755 /mnt/server/sync-station/pterodactyl/start.sh
rm -rf "$ROOMFLOW_INSTALL_SOURCE"
echo 'RoomFlow Sync Station files installed.'

variables.description: Full-length bcrypt password for HTTP access to noVNC, also used by the inner VNC session. Username: roomflow. Use at least 16 random characters.
